name: fs_search_files
description: This tool allows you to recursively search for files whose names match a glob pattern beneath a directory root. Use this tool to locate files when you only know part of the name. Matching is case insensitive by default. The search skips symlinked directories to avoid cycles and respects the server sandbox, so results never include paths you cannot subsequently read.

root.description: Absolute path of the directory to search beneath.

pattern.description: Glob pattern applied to the file name, e.g. *.test.ts or config.*.

pagination.title: Pagination options
pagination.description: Standard cursor-based pagination controls shared by every list endpoint in this server.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in the previous page of results. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page. The server clamps values above the maximum.
